emergency.2: All allied units gain 15% maximum health.
emergency.3: With 3 different Emergency units on the field, allies inside a Medkit's area deal 50% more melee and ranged damage. Explosions and afterburn are excluded.
emergency.5: After 6 different Emergency unit instances receive healing, an extra Emergency unit from your deck joins the battle. Each instance counts once.

northerners.2: After a Northerner kills an enemy, their next attack is a guaranteed critical hit.
northerners.3: With 3 different Northerners on the field, newly deployed Northerners always land a critical hit with their first attack.
northerners.5: Northerners gain 50 percentage points of critical damage.

college.2: Each College unit gains 10% critical damage per 90 points of their own charisma.
college.3: With 3 different College units on the field, College units gain 80% charisma.
college.5: College kills summon a random College unit from your deck: initially after 3 kills with +7% damage. Each summon adds 3 required kills and another 7% damage.

military.2: Military units below 10% health have a 30% chance to avoid incoming damage.
military.3: After 3 different Military units reach the field, every 2 Military deaths can summon SpecOps with a 50% chance.
military.5: Enemies ignore Military units until those units attempt an attack. Opposing Military units can still target them.

patriots.2: Patriot attacks have a 15% chance to ignite enemies.
patriots.3: With 3 different Patriots on the field, fire and afterburn damage from human units and support items is doubled.

tmf.2: TMF units have a 50% chance to avoid each instance of explosion damage.
tmf.3: Deploying a third different TMF unit summons one extra random TMF unit from your deck. Activates once per battle.
tmf.5: Deploying a TMF unit has a 50% chance to reduce a random deck unit's cost by 5, down to zero. Can trigger 10 times per battle.

builders.2: Start with a Red Barrel and Nitrogen on the field. Skirmish and wave-based modes use two Red Barrels instead.
builders.3: Deploying a third different Builder summons one extra random Builder from your deck. Activates once per battle.
builders.5: Builders gain 5% damage per Empty Barrel or Red Barrel currently on the field.

if.2: Enemies within a Medkit's area move 50% slower and take extra damage equal to its healing percentage.
if.3: With 3 different IF units on the field, a Medkit appears at a random location every 20 seconds. Its level matches your equipped Medkit; otherwise it is level 0.
if.5: Medkits last 50% longer, providing 12 healing pulses instead of 8.

mechanic.2: Each deployed Mechanic repairs the bus by 5% of its maximum health.
mechanic.3: With 3 different Mechanics on the field, deploying a Mechanic has a 25% chance to create a Turret; Welder has a 50% chance. Equip a Turret to use its upgraded level.
mechanic.5: Turrets take half as much self-damage from overheating.

jailers.2: Support items require 30% less preparation time.
jailers.3: With 3 different Jailers on the field, their critical hits have a 25% chance to stun enemies.
jailers.5: All human units and support items require 30% less preparation time.

psychos.2: Psycho critical hits have a 25% chance to drop a pack containing 13 rage points.
psychos.3: With 3 different Psychos on the field, a rage pack from their critical-hit bonus gives permanent Fury to a random ally.
psychos.5: Enemies killed by your units or attacks have a 10% chance to drop 20 rage points.

police.2: Ranged units receive one extra base magazine of ammunition, up to 60 shots.
police.3: Once 3 different Police units are on the field, the third and subsequently deployed Police units receive a shield worth 25% of their maximum health.
police.5: When a Police unit dies, Police allies already on the field receive Fury for 10 seconds.

marines.2: Private Rodriguez's main Marine appearance gains 100 agility and aggression, removing pauses between attacks.
marines.3: With 3 different Marines on the field, newly deployed ranged Marines receive 100 agility.
marines.5: All Marines receive 100 aggression, removing pauses between their attacks.

rednecks.2: Each time a Redneck takes damage, there is a 5% chance to drop 25 courage points.
rednecks.3: With 3 different Rednecks on the field, spawning a courage pack fully heals one random allied unit.
rednecks.5: Each Redneck death has a 25% chance to drop 25 courage points.

scientists.2: Explosion damage from your units and support items is doubled.
scientists.3: With 3 different Scientists on the field, a dying Scientist summons a Drone to attack their killer. Equip a Drone to use its upgraded level.
scientists.5: Each enemy killed makes Scientists deal 10% more damage to that enemy type. Stacks up to 100 kills and resets between waves or PvP battles.

prisoners.2: Prisoners gain 50% melee damage resistance when deployed. The bonus is lost on death, even if the unit is revived.
prisoners.3: With 3 different Prisoners on the field, Prisoners have a 50% chance to avoid each enemy's first attack. Status effects can still be applied.
prisoners.5: Prisoners deal 10% more damage for each different negative status effect on their target. Fear does not count.

southerners.2: The frontmost allied human unit gains a shield worth 30% of its maximum health. The shield is lost if another unit moves ahead.
southerners.3: With 3 different Southerners on the field, a Southerner's death heals all allies for 20% of that unit's maximum health.
southerners.5: Newly deployed Southerners gain 5% damage, plus 10% per 30 courage points available at deployment.

delivery.2: Delivery units have a 25% chance to avoid damage. An avoided attack may still apply status effects.
delivery.3: With 3 different Delivery units on the field, Delivery units attacking the same target gain 6% damage per participating Delivery unit.
delivery.5: After avoiding damage, Delivery units have a 50% chance to double the damage of their next attack.
